summary: Pass-through POP used as a stable output/reference point for POP chains. Helps keep downstream references stable while internal POP logic changes.

key_params.name: display
key_params.note: Display flag should mark the intended POP output during debugging

common_gotchas: A Null POP with no input is not a meaningful particle output; ensure the upstream POP chain is connected.
Use POP inspection to validate point counts, attributes, and finite bounds.
